Read the kube-bench results: kubectl get configmap kube-bench-results -n dojo-sec-cis -o jsonpath='{.data.output}' — look for lines starting with [PASS] and [FAIL].
Read the checklist: kubectl get configmap cis-checklist -n dojo-sec-cis -o jsonpath='{.data.checklist}' — these 5 checks need to be [PASS] in the output for verify.sh to succeed.
Run bash verify.sh — it checks for [PASS] status on checks 1.2.1, 1.2.7, 1.2.16, 4.2.1, 4.2.2 in the kube-bench output ConfigMap and outputs the flag if all pass.
